description: This file defines the 'Home' component for a notes application, structured with LightningJS. It composes a header, notes list, and editor pane, handling selection, creation, and update/deletion events, as well as keyboard shortcuts for focus management.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: Main LightningJS component representing the home page with header, notes list, and editor pane, managing state and events.

methods.name: $handleSelect
methods.description: Handles selection of a note from the notes list, updating the internal 'selected' state.

methods.name: $handleCreate
methods.description: Handles creation of a new note from the notes list and sets it as selected.
